support_provenance.limits: Initial fixed supports only. Prior discovery cost must be counted separately;this run cannot establish fresh selection generalization or end-to-end discovery timing.

objective: Equal-example full-response correction CE plus KL(base||current) on the original six canonical preservation contexts. Full-batch gradients each proposal;all representations use identical measured acceptance and stopping.
stopping: Stop at every correction token including EOS probability>=0.9,60 proposals,or failure of all four backtracks. No held-out output chooses a checkpoint or retries. No accepted update is a valid unsuccessful adaptation outcome.
preservation: Measure absolute mean and worst-token anchored KL from the frozen base after each provisional Adam update;require task-loss improvement. Fully restore rejected parameters,gradients,Adam state and RNG. Same numerical limits apply to every method. No held-out teacher bank or generated answer influences acceptance.
comparison: Official rank-one MLP LoRA and random seed11 are known strong controls from the prior completed study. Use the shared previously successful low rate0.0003;do not select a new rate after observing outputs. Report both live and merged complete answers after real save/reload.
success: A risk-aware candidate must achieve8/8 requested merged transfer answers across both exposed facts,with no new unambiguous preservation factual errors and no truncation,while satisfying both mean and worst preservation budgets after merging. Both matched random and official LoRA controls must also complete8/8 edits for an informative superiority comparison. At equal complete-answer success,the candidate must reduce held-out mean KL by>=20% versus each of those two controls in each case without worse factual preservation. If a control fails editing,the superiority comparison is inconclusive rather than an automatic win. Report the gradient-only ablation,all failed fits,and all phases of cost separately,including the cached support provenance;do not claim measured whole-pipeline speed from cached supports. Any positive result only licenses fresh confirmation,not a robust recipe.
limits: Changed method after an explicitly failed previous gate;that result remains failed. Two exposed development facts and canonical preservation contexts. No novel-optimizer claim or reproduction of paper training. Cached supports do not measure whole-pipeline speed. Full neuron selection,additional parameter/data budgets,another task family and fresh cases remain required.
